review_candidates.title: Partner Support Team Leader
review_candidates.description: Position Summary As a Contact Center Team Leader, you will lead a multi-channel customer support team handling calls, email, and chat, ensuring every interaction reflects Property Finder's commitment to service excellence. You own the day-to-day floor operations of your team, driving performance against SLAs, quality, and productivity targets across all channels. You will coach, motivate, and develop your agents, resolve escalations, and use real-time data to keep service levels on track. Beyond daily operations, you act as a bridge between your team and Workforce Management, Quality, and Training functions, identifying process gaps and driving improvements that raise the standard of service. Ultimately, your purpose is to build a high-performing, engaged team that delivers a consistently excellent, fast, and reliable experience to every customer who reaches out to Property Finder, reinforcing our reputation as the region's leading real estate platform. Key Responsibilities Manage daily operations across voice, email, and chat channels, ensuring SLAs, response times, and quality standards are consistently met. Monitor real-time queues and adjust staffing, breaks, and schedules to maintain service levels across all channels. Coach, mentor, and conduct regular 1:1s and performance reviews with team members; identify skill gaps and build individual development plans. Review call, chat, and email interactions for quality assurance and provide timely, actionable feedback. Handle escalations and complex customer cases that require supervisor-level intervention. Track and report on KPIs (AHT, FRT, CSAT, occupancy, adherence, backlog) and share insights with management. Drive team engagement, motivation, and retention through recognition and a positive team culture. Ensure adherence to schedules, attendance, and shift-adherence policies. Collaborate with QA, Workforce Management, and Training teams to improve processes and agent performance. Identify recurring issues or process gaps and propose improvements to leadership. Support hiring, onboarding, and training of new team members. Ensure compliance with company policies, data protection, and customer service standards. The Person Desired Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Business Administration or a relevant field. Fluency in Arabic and English (written and spoken). Proficient with CRM/helpdesk tools (e.g., Zendesk, Salesforce, or similar) and reporting dashboards. Expected Years Of Experience 3+ years of experience in a contact center environment. At least 2 year in a team lead or supervisory role. Experience managing multi-channel support (voice, email, chat) preferred. Skills Strong knowledge of contact center KPIs and workforce management principles. Excellent coaching, leadership, and conflict-resolution skills. Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into action. Ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment, including flexible/shift-based schedules. Familiarity with QA scoring frameworks and call/chat monitoring tools. Clear, confident communication with both agents and senior stakeholders. Cross-functional collaboration with different teams/departments, such as Legal, Finance, Product, and Engineering. Track record of driving process enhancements that improve efficiency, quality, or customer experience. Comfortable identifying automation opportunities to reduce manual/repetitive work across channels. Curious and proactive about using AI tools to find creative solutions to operational challenges. Behavioral Competencies High accountability and ownership; sees issues through to resolution. Calm and composed under pressure, always solution-focused. Proactive mindset with a continuous improvement focus. Trusted leader who builds credibility quickly with team and stakeholders. Embodies Property Finder's values of trust, innovation, and customer obsession. Our promise to talent At Property Finder, we believe talent thrives in an environment where you can be your best self. Where you are empowered to create, elevate, grow, and care. Our team is made up of the best and brightest, united by a shared ambition to change living for good in the region. We attract top talent who want to make an impact. We firmly believe that when our people grow, we all succeed. review_candidates.description: Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies. This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems. A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality. Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on. You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies. You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines. Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards. Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues. Strong UI skills, with a sharp eye for layout, typography and detail. Fluent Arabic and English, written and spoken. Ability to work on-site at our office in Heliopolis, Cairo.

review_candidates.title: Tech Lead (Hands-on) - Full Stack
review_candidates.description: Property Finder is the leading property portal in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region, dedicated to shaping an inclusive future for real estate while spearheading the region’s growing tech ecosystem. At its core is a clear and powerful purpose: To change living for good in the region. Founded on the value of great ambitions, Property Finder connects millions of property seekers with thousands of real estate professionals every day. The platform offers a seamless and enriching experience, empowering both buyers and renters to make informed decisions. Since its inception in 2007, Property Finder has evolved into a trusted partner for developers, brokers, and home seekers. As a lighthouse tech company, it continues to create an environment where people can thrive and contribute meaningfully to the transformation of real estate in MENA. About The Role This is a hands-on Tech Lead role: you’ll spend about 80% of your time writing, reviewing and shipping code. You’ll build across the stack of the region’s leading property marketplace, from the Next.js web experience to the TypeScript and Go services behind it, where latency, reliability and cost directly shape the experience of millions of buyers, renters and agents. You’ll lead the team’s technical work from inside the codebase. You’ll set direction through the code you write, the designs you propose and the reviews you give. What You’ll Build (about 80% of your time) Ship features end to end, from the React/Next.js UI through the TypeScript (Node.js) and Go services, APIs and data stores behind it, all the way to production Design and build APIs and service boundaries that other teams can safely depend on Make the web fast and findable: server-side rendering, caching, Core Web Vitals, SEO-critical pages and Arabic right-to-left layouts Evolve our existing Go services while building new ones in TypeScript, and keep both well tested and easy to change Own what you ship in production: instrument it, define SLOs and alerts, join the on-call rotation, debug incidents and fix root causes Build product ideas behind feature flags and A/B experiments, then use production metrics to judge what worked Prototype quickly to de-risk an idea before the team commits to it Improve the team’s engineering foundations, such as tests, CI/CD, local development and observability, so everyone ships faster Where the Other 20% Goes Design: write short design docs for significant changes and review the ones your teammates write Mentoring: grow the engineers around you through pairing, reviews and example, not status meetings Planning: work with product managers and designers to break work into small, shippable pieces, and flag technical risk and cost early Hiring: take part in interview loops, including the coding rounds Cross-team work: align with mobile, platform and data engineers on shared APIs and engineering standards Required Skills What We’re Looking For 6+ years writing production code across frontend and backend, with significant time on high-traffic, consumer-facing systems. You still write code most days. Deep, current expertise in TypeScript (Node.js) and React/Next.js. You can take a feature from an empty file to production on your own. Go experience, or the ability to pick it up quickly: several of our existing services are written in Go Strong backend design skills: microservice architectures, API design (REST/gRPC), service boundaries, inter-service communication and data modelling Hands-on experience with AWS and containerised deployments, and with databases and search such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, Elasticsearch and Redis, including data modelling, performance tuning and caching Solid web performance skills: server-side rendering, caching, bundle size and Core Web Vitals Testing discipline across unit, integration and end-to-end tests Production ownership: observability, SLOs, debugging live incidents and writing post-mortems that lead to real fixes A track record of technical leadership from inside the codebase: driving design decisions, setting review standards and mentoring engineers Clear written communication in design docs, pull requests and trade-off discussions with engineers and product partners Nice to have Experience building AI/LLM-backed features in production, including managing the latency, quality and cost of model calls Fluent use of AI coding assistants in your daily workflow, with the judgement to review what they produce Experience with event-driven architectures, edge computing (such as CDN-level logic) or multi-region systems Experience with SEO-critical web applications, internationalisation and right-to-left (Arabic) layouts Experience in marketplace, classifieds, or other two-sided platform products How You Work You lead by building: the team follows your code, designs and reviews, not your title You ship small and often, and you’d rather prove an idea with a prototype than debate it in a meeting You own outcomes in production, not just merged pull requests, and you watch the dashboards after a release You protect the quality bar in code review and production, while keeping the team shipping You’re pragmatic: you know when to invest in scale and when to ship the simple thing, and you can quantify the cost of both You make decisions with data and explain trade-offs clearly
